name: How long does it take to see results from implementing GEO schema markup?

mainEntity.name: How long does it take to see results from implementing GEO schema markup?

acceptedAnswer.text: The timeframe for observing results from GEO schema markup implementation can vary. Search engines need time to recrawl and reindex your website after the markup is added. While some improvements in rich snippet appearance or local pack visibility might be seen within a few weeks, significant shifts in local search rankings and organic traffic often take several weeks to a few months. Consistent, high-quality content and other SEO factors also influence the speed and extent of visible improvements.
acceptedAnswer.description: Results from GEO schema can appear within weeks, but significant improvements in local rankings and traffic typically take several weeks to a few months.
